comparison.objective: Tighten and fit an already-threaded necktie on a rigid collar form.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated pulling and fitting of a reduced deformable/fixed-topology tie model.
comparison.success_condition: Released 5-second hold with knot size, position, blade order, twist, and tip-length bounds; damage or unthreading fails.
comparison.reason: Tests deformable dressing adjustment rather than pouring, bimanual rigid-tool agitation, and particulate separation.
